tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger kneels on one knee and leans forward to tie a lace on its boot, left palm pressed flat on the floor for balance and sole of the right foot lifted toward the camera.
tasks.camera: low three-quarter close shot emphasizing the raised sole and planted palm
tasks.visibility_requirement: Left palm fully flat and visible with all five fingers, right sole raised facing camera with all four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 单膝跪地系鞋带，一手撑地一手操作，抬脚展示脚掌

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger performs a one-handed cartwheel across a sunny meadow, one palm planted with fingers splayed while the opposite foot swings high showing its sole.
tasks.camera: dynamic side tracking shot freezing mid-cartwheel with palm and sole both in frame
tasks.visibility_requirement: Planting palm completely visible with five fingers, swinging foot sole turned toward camera with four toes clear
tasks.intent_zh: 草地侧手翻，撑地手掌张开，摆动脚掌朝向镜头

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger sits on a high ledge and raises both bare feet toward the camera while pressing one palm against the wall beside it for support.
tasks.camera: front low-angle shot from below the ledge
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both soles fully facing camera with four toes each, supporting palm flat on wall with five fingers visible
tasks.intent_zh: 坐在高台边缘双脚抬起朝镜头，一手扶墙支撑

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger crouches low in a muddy garden bed, digging with one hand while the other foot's sole presses flat against a raised planter wall behind it.
tasks.camera: ground-level side shot looking past the digging hand toward the braced sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Digging hand palm and five fingers visible, braced sole flat against planter with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲在泥地花园里挖土，另一只脚掌抵住花坛墙

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger lies on its back under a car and reaches up with one palm to grip a wrench, while one bare sole pushes against the chassis above.
tasks.camera: worm's-eye view from beside the car looking up at palm and pressed sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Gripping palm and all five fingers visible, sole pressed upward facing camera with four toes distinguishable
tasks.intent_zh: 仰躺车底修车，手掌抓扳手，脚掌顶住底盘

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger balances on a slackline strung between trees, one sole flat on the line and one palm extended downward with fingers spread for stability.
tasks.camera: side medium shot with slight low angle capturing the flat sole and downspread palm
tasks.visibility_requirement: Balancing sole flat and fully visible with four toes, extended palm angled toward camera with five fingers clear
tasks.intent_zh: 走扁带保持平衡，脚掌踩线手掌下伸张开

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger climbs a vertical rock wall, one palm gripping a hold near its face and one sole planted on a lower hold with toes spread for grip.
tasks.camera: slightly below and behind the climber, framing the gripping palm and planted sole together
tasks.visibility_requirement: Gripping hand palm and five fingers visible around hold, planted sole with four toes and pads facing camera
tasks.intent_zh: 攀岩墙上抓握手点踩脚点，手掌脚掌同时可见

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger does a handstand against a brick wall, both palms flat on the ground while one bare foot rests against the wall showing its sole.
tasks.camera: low front shot tilted upward to include the ground palms and wall-pressed sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both flat palms with five fingers clearly visible, wall-resting sole facing camera with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 靠墙倒立，双掌撑地，一只脚掌贴墙朝向镜头

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger sits cross-legged on a woven mat weaving a basket, holding reeds with one palm open and resting the opposite sole upturned on its knee.
tasks.camera: medium front shot angled down at the lap showing the open palm and upturned sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Holding palm open and visible with five fingers, upturned sole clearly showing four toes and yellow pads
tasks.intent_zh: 坐垫上编篮子，一手摊开持草，另一脚掌翻起搁膝上

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger leaps between two rooftops, one palm reaching forward to grab a ledge and one trailing sole kicked up behind toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: rear tracking shot at rooftop height, focusing on the grabbing palm ahead and kicked sole behind
tasks.visibility_requirement: Forward grabbing palm with five fingers visible at ledge, trailing sole turned upward with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 屋顶间跳跃，前伸手掌抓边，后踢脚掌朝向镜头

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger kneels beside a shallow stream, one palm dipping flat into the water and one foot raised behind with sole facing the sky.
tasks.camera: side low shot near water level capturing the submerged palm and raised sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Submerged palm flat and five fingers still readable through water, raised sole facing camera with four toes
tasks.intent_zh: 溪边跪着手掌浸水，后抬脚掌朝上可见

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger presses both palms against a tall glass door and leans back on one heel with the other sole lifted flat against the glass.
tasks.camera: front medium shot from inside the building through the glass
tasks.visibility_requirement: Both palms flattened on glass with five fingers visible, pressed sole facing camera with four toes and pads clear

tasks.visibility_requirement: Thrusting palm facing camera with five fingers splayed, forward sole lifted slightly and facing camera with four toes clear

tasks.visibility_requirement: Edge-gripping palm with five fingers clear, raised rear sole facing camera with four toes and pads visible
tasks.intent_zh: 趴着滑滑梯，一手抓边，后抬脚掌朝镜头

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger stands on tiptoe to reach a high shelf, one palm stretching up and one lifted heel exposing the sole behind toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: rear three-quarter shot with low angle showing the reaching palm and lifted sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Reaching palm open with five fingers visible near shelf, lifted heel sole facing camera with four toes clear
tasks.intent_zh: 踮脚够高架，伸手掌，后脚跟抬起露脚掌

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger crouches on a boulder and paints a canvas propped on its knee, one palm holding a brush and one sole resting flat on the rock toward the viewer.
tasks.camera: side medium shot showing brush-holding palm and rock-resting sole together
tasks.visibility_requirement: Brush-holding palm with five fingers visible, sole flat on rock facing camera with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 蹲岩石上作画，一手持笔，脚掌平放岩石朝向镜头

tasks.visibility_requirement: Palm touching deck with five fingers visible, kicked-out sole facing camera with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 踩滑板蹲低，一手碰板面，侧踢脚掌朝镜头

tasks.visibility_requirement: Braced palm flat on frame with five fingers, sole pressed on opposite jamb facing camera with four toes clear
tasks.intent_zh: 门框后探身，一手撑框一脚掌抵门框

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger kneels to plant a small tree, one palm pressing soil and one foot sole resting flat on the shovel blade for leverage.
tasks.camera: ground-level side shot showing soil-pressing palm and shovel-resting sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Soil-pressing palm with five fingers visible, sole flat on shovel facing camera with four toes and pads clear

tasks.intent_zh: 沙滩俯卧撑，手掌撑地，后抬脚掌朝镜头

tasks.instruction: The adult blue tiger sits on a swing and pushes off, one palm gripping the rope and one bare sole pressed against a wooden post.

tasks.visibility_requirement: Rope-gripping palm with five fingers visible, post-pressed sole facing camera with four toes and pads clear

tasks.visibility_requirement: Supporting palm flat with five fingers clear, angled sole facing camera with four toes and pads distinct
tasks.intent_zh: 街舞单手撑地定格，劈叉一脚掌朝向镜头

tasks.camera: front low shot up the rope ladder framing the gripping palm and flat sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Gripping palm wrapped on rung with five fingers, sole flat on rung facing camera with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 爬绳梯，一手抓横档，脚掌踩档朝外

tasks.camera: inside-boat side shot showing scooping palm and hull-braced sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Scooping palm with five fingers visible, braced sole flat on hull facing camera with four toes and pads clear
tasks.intent_zh: 小船里舀水，手掌舀水，脚掌抵船内壁朝镜头

tasks.camera: low upward shot beneath the branch showing gripping palm and upturned sole
tasks.visibility_requirement: Branch-gripping palm with five fingers visible, upturned sole facing camera with four toes and pads distinct
